import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005, "lr": 0.001}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005, "lr": 0.001}

TW = 32
LH = 32
P = 16
HID = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.trunk_in = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, TW, 1)
        self.t1 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.t2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(TW, LH, 1)
        self.lin = nn.Conv2d(16, LH, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LH, LH, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(LH, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TW + LH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        t = F.relu(self.trunk_in(obs))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t1(t))
        t = F.relu(t + self.t2(t))
        L = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        Lp = F.pad(L, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        cols = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([Lp[:, :, 0:Z], Lp[:, :, 1:Z + 1], Lp[:, :, 2:Z + 2], cols, zc], dim=1)
        inp = inp.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 16, Y, X)
        c = self.ctx(t).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LH, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LH, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.lin(inp) + c)
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            o = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            o = o.reshape(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            w = torch.softmax(o[:, :, 0], dim=1)
            res.append((w * o[:, :, 1]).sum(1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, LH, Y, X).amax(dim=(1, 3, 4))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), hz], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

HID = 32
P = 16

        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, HID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), fc, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.mix, self.outs):

            a = fc(fq)
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(a + mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 4, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

W = 40
HID = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.nt = len(self.fps)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(3)])
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, HID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mid = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), fc, mid, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.mid, self.outs):
            fq = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(fc(fq))
            h = F.relu(h + mid(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 4, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
FP = 8


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.fproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, FP, 1)
        self.flat = nn.Linear(FP * Y * X + 64, self.n_place)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        fl = F.relu(self.fproj(f)).flatten(1)
        place = self.head(f) + self.flat(torch.cat([fl, g], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01, "lr": 0.001}

W = 40
P = 8
HH = 32
DIHEDRAL = True


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        shapes = []
        for s in fps:
            if s[0] * s[1] > 1 and s not in shapes:
                shapes.append(s)
        self.shapes = shapes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(2)])
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(W + 2 * P * len(shapes), HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.hmid = nn.Conv2d(HH, HH, 1)
        if DIHEDRAL:
            self.n_br = 8 if self.Y == self.X else 4
        else:
            self.n_br = 1
        self.outs = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.nt * self.n_br, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W + 2 * HH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        p = self.proj(f)
        feats = [f]
        for dy, dx in self.shapes:
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            feats.append(F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
            feats.append(-F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.hmid(h))
        o = self.outs(h).reshape(B, self.n_br, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        place = o[:, 0]
        if self.n_br > 1:
            place = place + o[:, 1].flip(2) + o[:, 2].flip(3) + o[:, 3].flip(2, 3)
        if self.n_br > 4:
            place = place + o[:, 4].transpose(2, 3) + o[:, 5].transpose(2, 3).flip(2) \
                + o[:, 6].transpose(2, 3).flip(3) + o[:, 7].transpose(2, 3).flip(2, 3)
        place = place.reshape(B, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01, "lr": 0.001}

W = 40
D = 24
NH = 6
HID = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.N = self.Y * self.X
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(2)])
        self.feat = nn.Conv2d(W, D, 1)
        self.gather = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(NH, self.N, self.N))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.amlp1 = nn.Linear(NH * D + 64 + self.nt, HID)
        self.amlp2 = nn.Linear(HID, self.nt)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        mflat = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.N)
        m = mflat.reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        v = self.feat(f).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        A = torch.softmax(self.gather, dim=-1)
        u = torch.einsum('han,bnd->bahd', A, v).reshape(B, self.N, NH * D)
        u = torch.cat([u, g.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, self.N, 64), mflat.transpose(1, 2)], dim=2)
        z = self.amlp2(F.relu(self.amlp1(u)))
        place = z.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, -1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01, "lr": 0.001}

W = 40
P = 8
HH = 32
DIHEDRAL = False


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        shapes = []
        for s in fps:
            if s[0] * s[1] > 1 and s not in shapes:
                shapes.append(s)
        self.shapes = shapes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(2)])
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(W + 2 * P * len(shapes), HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.hmid = nn.Conv2d(HH, HH, 1)
        if DIHEDRAL:
            self.n_br = 8 if self.Y == self.X else 4
        else:
            self.n_br = 1
        self.outs = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.nt * self.n_br, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W + 2 * HH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        p = self.proj(f)
        feats = [f]
        for dy, dx in self.shapes:
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            feats.append(F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
            feats.append(-F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.hmid(h))
        o = self.outs(h).reshape(B, self.n_br, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        place = o[:, 0]
        if self.n_br > 1:
            place = place + o[:, 1].flip(2) + o[:, 2].flip(3) + o[:, 3].flip(2, 3)
        if self.n_br > 4:
            place = place + o[:, 4].transpose(2, 3) + o[:, 5].transpose(2, 3).flip(2) \
                + o[:, 6].transpose(2, 3).flip(3) + o[:, 7].transpose(2, 3).flip(2, 3)
        place = place.reshape(B, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01, "lr": 0.001}

W = 40
P = 8
HH = 32


def orient(o, k):
    if k >= 4:
        o = o.transpose(2, 3)
    j = k % 4
    if j == 1:
        o = o.flip(2)
    elif j == 2:
        o = o.flip(3)
    elif j == 3:
        o = o.flip(2, 3)
    return o


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        shapes = []
        for s in fps:
            if s[0] * s[1] > 1 and s not in shapes:
                shapes.append(s)
        self.shapes = shapes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(2)])
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(W + 2 * P * len(shapes), HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.hmid = nn.Conv2d(HH, HH, 1)
        self.n_br = 8 if self.Y == self.X else 4
        self.outs = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.nt * self.n_br, 1)
        self.bgate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.n_br))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W + 2 * HH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        p = self.proj(f)
        feats = [f]
        for dy, dx in self.shapes:
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            feats.append(F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
            feats.append(-F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.hmid(h))
        o = self.outs(h).reshape(B, self.n_br, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        w = torch.softmax(self.bgate, dim=0) * self.n_br
        place = w[0] * o[:, 0]
        for k in range(1, self.n_br):
            place = place + w[k] * orient(o[:, k], k)
        place = place.reshape(B, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01, "lr": 0.001}

W = 40
P = 8
HH = 32
GC = 16


def orient(o, k):
    if k >= 4:
        o = o.transpose(2, 3)
    j = k % 4
    if j == 1:
        o = o.flip(2)
    elif j == 2:
        o = o.flip(3)
    elif j == 3:
        o = o.flip(2, 3)
    return o


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        shapes = []
        for s in fps:
            if s[0] * s[1] > 1 and s not in shapes:
                shapes.append(s)
        self.shapes = shapes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(3)])
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * W, GC)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(W + GC + 2 * P * len(shapes), HH, 3, padding=1)
        self.hmid = nn.Conv2d(HH, HH, 1)
        self.n_br = 8 if self.Y == self.X else 4
        self.outs = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.nt * self.n_br, 1)
        self.bgate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.n_br))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W + 2 * HH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        fpool = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        gc = F.relu(self.gctx(fpool)).view(B, GC, 1, 1).expand(B, GC, self.Y, self.X)
        p = self.proj(f)
        feats = [f, gc]
        for dy, dx in self.shapes:
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            feats.append(F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
            feats.append(-F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1))
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.hmid(h))
        o = self.outs(h).reshape(B, self.n_br, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        w = torch.softmax(self.bgate, dim=0) * self.n_br
        place = w[0] * o[:, 0]
        for k in range(1, self.n_br):
            place = place + w[k] * orient(o[:, k], k)
        place = place.reshape(B, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([fpool, h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so it learned nothing useful in 131k steps with 4 PPO epochs (only 32 updates). That makes training too short, or too few updates, the most likely first problem, ahead of the network design. Three ideas: (1) trade PPO epochs for more samples and updates, with gamma raised so the +1 exact-build bonus counts for more; (2) add structure that matches the task. A brick is right only if the layer it lands on is the correct target layer across its whole footprint. A head that scores each anchor per layer and learns a soft gate for the landing layer should make that easier to learn; (3) a cheaper, deeper 2D network with a learned convolution over each brick's footprint, trained with 1 epoch for the most samples. With the baseline at 0, any score that is clearly above 0 on both seeds would be meaningful.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success, so round 1 gives no ranking between architectures or recipes. One thing it does show: round 1 cut the number of gradient steps. The baseline gets 32 updates × 4 epochs × 32 minibatches = 4096 steps. r1c1 got about 1.8k and r1c3 about 0.8k, so 'more samples' came at the cost of far fewer updates. With only about 9k episodes in the budget, PPO probably needs many small updates. Round 2 uses 64 environments with rollout 16 (about 125 updates and about 8k gradient steps). It tests this on the baseline net, on a deeper net with a footprint-conv head, and on a hedge net. The hedge covers the warning that the world may differ from its description: if the action anchoring or orientation does not match the obs grid, local conv heads cannot learn it. So it adds a flattened linear action head and feeds the mask (which is laid out by action index) as input.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0, on dev and in training. That covers 1, 2 and 4 PPO epochs, 98k to 426k steps, update counts from 32 to 125, and several head designs, so the recipe and the amount of capacity do not look like the bottleneck. The task warns that the world may not match its description. The most likely hidden mismatch is how action indices map onto the observation grid: transposed axes, flipped axes, a different anchor corner or a swapped footprint order. Every head so far assumes the stated top-left anchor and footprint order. The flat head in r2c3 could in principle learn any mapping, but a dense map learned from scratch with RL is very sample-hungry. This round tests the mapping hypothesis directly. P1 adds every flip and transpose of the action grid, with a 3x3 head to absorb a one-cell anchor shift. P3 is the same network with only the stated mapping, as a control. P2 learns a gather from any cells to each anchor.
analyses.4: r3c1 is the only trial with any successes. It sums the placement output over all 8 flips and transposes of the grid and scored 0.111 (0.078 and 0.145 on its two seeds). r3c3 used the same network and recipe with only the described action layout and scored 0.000. So the action layout probably differs from the description by a flip or transpose. Every trial without the flipped and transposed outputs scored 0, whatever the recipe or capacity, so those earlier zeros say little about recipes or network size. Training success (0.12) is close to dev success, which suggests the network is underfitting rather than overfitting. r3c1 trained in only 28 seconds. All three candidates keep the flipped and transposed outputs and change one thing each: a learned weight on each output so the wrong orientations can be switched off quickly, a recipe that gives more credit to the exact-build bonus, and a third residual block plus whole-board context in the head.
